scripts.build: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')){ fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html','dist/404.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html','404.html'); if(!fs.existsSync('assets')) fs.mkdirSync('assets'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/assets/app.js')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/app.js','assets/app.js'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/assets/app.css')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/app.css','assets/app.css'); if(!fs.existsSync('docs')) fs.mkdirSync('docs'); if(!fs.existsSync('docs/assets')) fs.mkdirSync('docs/assets'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html','docs/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('dist/index.html','docs/404.html'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/assets/app.js')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/app.js','docs/assets/app.js'); if(fs.existsSync('dist/assets/app.css')) fs.copyFileSync('dist/assets/app.css','docs/assets/app.css'); fs.writeFileSync('.nojekyll',''); fs.writeFileSync('docs/.nojekyll',''); fs.writeFileSync('dist/.nojekyll',''); }"
